# resend_domain (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Resend sending domain by ID. Returns the same shape as the `resend_domain` resource minus the write-only `custom_return_path` field.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5"

  required_providers {
    resend = {
      source  = "armaaar/resend"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "resend" {}

# Read an existing Resend domain by ID — useful when the domain was created
# in the Resend dashboard or by another Terraform state and you only want to
# reference its records / capabilities here.
data "resend_domain" "shared" {
  id = "dom_abc123"
}

output "shared_domain_status" {
  description = "Verification status of the shared Resend domain."
  value       = data.resend_domain.shared.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the domain within Resend.

### Read-Only

- `capabilities` (Attributes) Resend-determined domain capabilities. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capabilities))
- `click_tracking` (Boolean) Whether outbound links are rewritten to track click events.
- `created_at` (String) The date and time the domain was created at Resend.
- `name` (String) The fully-qualified domain name.
- `open_tracking` (Boolean) Whether outbound links are rewritten to track open events.
- `records` (Attributes List) DNS records that must exist at the domain's DNS provider for Resend to verify and send through this domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))
- `region` (String) The region emails are sent from.
- `status` (String) The verification status of the domain.
- `tls` (String) Outbound TLS policy. One of `enforced` or `opportunistic`. Null when no policy is set.
- `tracking_subdomain` (String) The subdomain Resend uses to host tracking pixels and click redirects.
